terms.gloss: the clitoris: the anatomical word, from the Greek

evidence: M-O s.v. genitals: clitoris (Cael. Aur. Gyn. 2.112)
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens calls it obscene in classical Latin and quotes it from the medical writer Caelius Aurelianus. Lewis & Short has the word only from a glossary, with a Greek gloss and no English.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. genitals: clitoris.
